programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: When a national day of mourning in London for a fallen leader turns into a horrific terrorist attack, the clock begins ticking for Mike Banning, a seasoned Secret Service agent, and President Asher. What starts as a solemn funeral quickly devolves into chaos as heavily armed insurgents storm the event, resulting in unprecedented violence across the city. Banning, determined to save the President, navigates through a landscape filled with misinformation and danger, uncovering a deeper conspiracy led by the vengeful arms dealer Aamir Barkawi, whose ties to global terrorism threaten more than just the safety of those physically present. With the breakdown of communication channels and infiltration of key security measures, the protagonist must rely on quick thinking and adrenaline-fueled action to outsmart the enemy. The lives of countless civilians are at stake as Banning engages in a tense battle against time, aiming not only to rescue the President but also to dismantle a profoundly dangerous network designed to sow chaos and destruction worldwide. As the crisis unfolds, it becomes more than just a fight for survival; it's a terrifying examination of the fragility of peace and the price of freedom in a convoluted world.

programme.title: Jimmy O. Yang: Guess How Much?
programme.desc: Yang dives into love languages, loser friends and negotiating with his Asian parents.

programme.title: Bill Engvall: Here's Your Sign: It's Finally Time: My Last Show
programme.desc: Bill Engvall, renowned comedian, entertains audiences for the last time.

programme.title: Bob Saget: Zero to Sixty
programme.desc: Bob Saget declares himself to be the last TV father viewers can trust in his hour of entertaining stories, riffing with the audience, words of wisdom and new original comedy songs.

programme.title: Bob Saget: That's What I'm Talkin' About
programme.desc: Bob Saget takes to the stage with a filthy song in his heart as he lets loose and embraces the dark side as he tells his favorite dirty jokes and stories about his dad - the guy who made him like this.

programme.title: Harland Williams: What a Treat
programme.desc: Stand-up comic Harland Williams takes center stage at the El Rey Theatre in Los Angeles for a riotous evening of laughs; featured topics range from everyman observations on fingernails and fried food to musings on dating and the Pillsbury Doughboy.

programme.title: Jeff Garcia: Low Budget Madness
programme.desc: The comic performs.

programme.title: Jenny McCarthy's Dirty Sexy Funny
programme.desc: Female comedians Paula Bel, Tiffany Haddish, Lynne Koplitz, Justine Marino and Tammy Pescatelli join Jenny McCarthy to shed some light on what it's really like to be a woman.

programme.title: Kevin Nealon: Whelmed but Not Overly
programme.desc: The comic performs in Denver; topics include the fears, insecurities and doubts of parenthood.

programme.title: Josh Gondelman: People Pleaser
programme.desc: Josh Gondelman performs in his debut special and the pressures of appearing in his friends' dreams.

programme.title: Helen Hong: Well Hong
programme.desc: Standup comic Helen Hong recounts spending her COVID-19 quarantine trying to date doomsday preppers and trying to teach the world that China is not the only country in Asia.

programme.title: Nemr: No Bombing in Beirut
programme.desc: Filmed in Lebanon and America, the comic discusses his childhood in America and his later years in Lebanon.

programme.title: Anjelah Johnson: Mahalo & Goodnight

programme.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Hot and Fluffy
programme.desc: Filmed at the Fox Theater in Bakersfield, California the comedian and well-known favorite to television viewers as being on "Last Comic Standing," performs impressions and silly voices.

programme.title: Jimmy O. Yang: Good Deal
programme.desc: From the Neptune Theater in Seattle, the comic talks about his interactions with immigrant parents, gives his thoughts on Matt Damon and asks whether ghosts are likely to haunt one-bedroom apartments.

programme.title: Alonzo Bodden: Who's Paying Attention?
programme.desc: The comic discusses the decline of civilization, the rise of pop culture, and swine flu.

programme.title: Jay Mohr: Altamont
